references.text: The tribe of Simeon received cities within the inheritance of Judah, including Molada, which is also mentioned here in Joshua 15:26
Shema is mentioned as one of the spies sent out from the wilderness of Sinai, and the name is connected to the place name Shema mentioned in this text
Molada is mentioned again as a city where Judah's descendants lived after returning from exile
Molada may be linked to the area where Hagar's son Ishmael and his descendants lived in the wilderness to the south
